item.title: [7.6] US stocks: US market falls as hot inflation, hawkish Fed fuel rate-hike fears
item.description:

US stocks closed lower on Tuesday after hotter-than-expected inflation data strengthened expectations of a Federal Reserve rate increase in December and raised concerns that policymakers could tighten monetary policy more aggressively, Reuters reported.The Labor Department said the Consumer Price Index rose 0.4% in October, exceeding the 0.3% increase forecast by economists polled by Reuters....
